sections.title: Scenario events
sections.note: Meet her at this place and time to start the scene; talking costs 1 Heart Clock. Bond choices: +25 small, +50 medium, +100 big. Some days have different scenes depending on her Connection level. "Unlimited" scenes repeat after day 21.

rows.label: I find Mica in the dormitory.

rows.text: It's a reinvigorating feeling, isn't it?
That's a strange way of thinking about it.

rows.label: I find Mica at the waterfall.

rows.text: Maybe a bit too powerful...
I hope it does imbue you with its energy.

rows.label: I find Mica at the waterfall.

rows.text: I'll stay here with you, so you can relax.
Calm down. This is all in your mind.

rows.label: I find Mica in the dormitory.

rows.text: It's amazing.
It's not all that different from what we see in the Ark.

rows.label: I find Mica at the waterfall.

rows.text: Wouldn't it be better to give her some space first?
Try and make her feel at home.

rows.label: I find Mica in the dormitory.

rows.text: That's kind of you to say.
You saying that has just made my day.

rows.label: I find Mica at the waterfall.

rows.text: Hmm... I haven't given it much thought.
I want to set off fireworks with you.

rows.label: I find Mica in the restaurant.

rows.text: Sure, thanks.
What's that?

rows.label: I find Mica at the walking trail.

rows.text: It looks like the ribbon you have on your waist.
It looks like the broom that you use when you're cleaning.

rows.label: I find Mica at the walking trail.

rows.text: I'm not sure about the specific name, but... the big one?
The sparklers were really fantastic.

rows.label: I find Mica in the dormitory.

rows.text: Okay, fine. We all did our part.
Yeah, you're right. Ludmilla and I did have a rougher go of it.

rows.label: I find Mica at the hot spring.

rows.text: Why don't you use this bucket?
Why don't you utilize waves?

rows.label: I find Mica at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: You're right. It's nice.
I dunno, sounds a little creepy to me.

rows.label: I find Mica in the dormitory.

rows.text: I should go try and find her, then.
I'll help you keep lookout.

rows.label: I find Mica in the dormitory.

rows.text: Comfort Mica.
Get Mica off me.

rows.label: I find Mica in the dormitory.

rows.text: You being there made me feel secure as well. So thank you.
I'm proud of you. It's like you're all grown up.

rows.label: I find Mica at the hot spring.

rows.text: It'll probably just be a normal event.
I assume it'll have something to do with luck.

rows.label: I find Mica at the hot spring.

rows.text: I was just thinking about the lucky hot spring event.
I was bored and had nothing else to do.

rows.label: I find Mica in the restaurant.

rows.text: Yes, please.
No, I'd prefer a cold beverage.

rows.label: I find Mica at the hot spring.

rows.text: Startle Mica.
Go beside her and dip your feet in.

rows.label: I find Mica in the restaurant.

rows.text: Let's eat together.
Thank you.

rows.label: I find Mica in the dormitory.

rows.text: We'll see them again when we head back.
I'm sad too.

rows.label: I find Mica at the walking trail.

rows.text: Well, that's not the case today.
Today, I'm here to talk to you.

rows.label: I find Mica at the walking trail.

rows.text: It's nice to see you two becoming closer.
That's good progress, but don't you think you should try a little harder to get closer to her?

rows.label: I find Mica at the walking trail.

rows.text: Cheer up. You'll get there soon enough.
Maybe some people just don't have what it takes.

rows.label: I find Mica at the walking trail.

rows.text: Absolutely, I'd love to join you.
I have plans later, sorry.

rows.label: I find Mica in the dormitory.

rows.text: What a cute snowman.
Wouldn't it be better if it was a bit bigger?

rows.label: I find Mica at the walking trail.

rows.text: I'm worried about whether they'll be able to endure this cold.
I'm sure they will.

rows.label: I find Mica at the walking trail.

rows.text: I thought the same thing, which is why I came.
Why?

rows.label: I find Mica at the waterfall.

rows.text: You don't think that you'll forget them before long?
Your perseverance is admirable.

rows.label: I find Mica at the waterfall.

rows.text: I didn't keep you waiting long, did I?
Can you welcome me more warmly?

rows.label: I find Mica at the waterfall.

rows.text: I came here to watch the waterfall.
I wanted to talk to you before leaving.

rows.label: I find Mica at the waterfall.

rows.text: I came since I wanted to see you.
I was bored.

rows.label: I find Mica at the hot spring.

rows.text: I came since I wanted to see you.
I was bored.

rows.label: I find Mica at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: I came since I wanted to see you.
I wanted to take a walk.

sections.title: Mica's mood by level
sections.note: The diary line shown at each Connection level.
items: She seems more interested in the legend of stone skipping now.
She's trying hard to skip stones.
She decides to practice stone skipping more.
She seems to have grown curious about Lumi, who brought over some stones.
She wonders if Lumi is a stone skipping expert.
She thinks she has no talent in stone skipping.
She seems a bit regretful, yet still pleased enough.
She looks delighted about successfully skipping a stone.
